patch.title: The Frequency home announces the beta (free through December 1) and every feature CTA on it leads to the one beta entry at /join

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const b=fs.readFileSync('components/frequency/site/pages/home/frequency-home.tsx','utf8');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/site-pages-a.css','utf8');const bad=[];if(!b.includes('className=\"beta-pill\"'))bad.push('no beta pill in the hero');if(!b.includes('id=\"beta\"'))bad.push('no beta band');if(!b.includes(\"BETA_UNTIL = 'December 1'\"))bad.push('no December 1 end date');if(!b.includes(\"BETA_CTA = 'Join the beta'\"))bad.push('no Join the beta CTA');const acts=b.match(/[{] href: [^,]+, icon:/g)||[];if(acts.length<24||acts.some(a=>!a.includes('SITE.join')))bad.push('a chapter Acts link skips /join');if(/className=\"pd [lr]\" data-set/.test(b)||!/<Link className=\"pd l\" href=[{]SITE.join[}]/.test(b))bad.push('path doors do not lead to /join');if(!/<div className=\"dock\">[\s\S]*href=[{]SITE.join[}]/.test(b))bad.push('dock has no beta button');if(/href=[{]SITE.(people|spaces)[}]>/.test(b))bad.push('a feature CTA still points past /join');if(!b.includes('the rhythm that keeps them')||!b.includes('Founding members set the rhythm here'))bad.push('no rhythm copy pass');if(!c.includes('.pa-home .bb{'))bad.push('beta band unstyled');if(bad.length){console.error('SCAN-885: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"

append.detail: RE-PINNED 2026-10-19 (SCAN-1017): the owner answered the beta end date card with December 1, the day the beta_grace window closes and the help centre already named, so BETA_UNTIL and BETA_ENDS_LABEL (lib/core/beta-notices.ts) both say December 1 and this probe pins that date instead of January 1. The CTA, door and copy checks are unchanged.
